verdict.rationale: Convex schemas are optional code files in the project, so they can live in version control. The CLI watches the filesystem and pushes schema changes to the dev deployment (convex-docs-6, convex-docs-17). This is Convex's own mechanism for applying schema changes via the CLI, but nothing in the pack shows a migration framework, data backfills, or CI/production rollout. missing for 10: documented versioned migration files or tooling for data migrations, a CLI deploy command for production/CI, guidance on handling breaking schema changes, independent corroboration.
